_finding: BOTH stores fail the >= 0.80 gate, and the CONTROL is the finding: the incumbent `ROUTE` intro store — the store the approved smoke prompts were built on and the store the build would otherwise use — reads 0.590 on health and 0.315 on finance. Its base precision had never been measured; only the MARGINAL of a widening ever was, against the same 0.80 bar. On the judged standard `wikipedia-body` is indistinguishable from the incumbent on health (-0.045, z = -0.91) and much better on finance (+0.220, z = 4.44). So 'not adopted' does not return the build to a store that meets the bar; it returns it to one that is worse on finance and no better on health.
_registered_outcome: The gate is >= 0.80 and it was registered before the scan. `wikipedia-body` is NOT ADOPTED on this evidence. Whether an 80% bar written for the marginal of a keyword widening is the right bar for a whole seed population is a Tier-3 question and is Dylan's, not mine — and it must not be answered by moving the bar now that the numbers are observed.
_next_lever: Registered, and aimed precisely at what the judges named: a SUBJECT-level filter, never a relaxed floor. Every failure class is an article-subject error — physician and researcher biographies, hospitals/journals/companies/banks as institutions, an illness inside a career biography, animal and plant disease, reference and category fragments, and word-sense errors ('bank' as a landform, 'trade' as a craft, 'trades' as player trades). The lead sentence of a Wikipedia article is its definition and is already excluded from the seeds, so routing on it costs nothing and leaks nothing.
